bolt11_pay.note: Single-part payments from Send; Winnow finds the route from the invoice hints and the public graph

bolt11_receive.note: Single-use invoice with a provider route hint; the app must stay open

bolt12_pay.note: Requests an invoice from the offer over onion messages, then a separate route and fee review; async static invoices too

bolt12_receive.note: Reusable offer once a channel has inbound capacity; the app must be open to answer. Offline offers need an async provider profile

offline_receive.note: LDK-style async hold/release via imported profile only; no push

lnurl.note: No LNURL code; send takes BOLT 11 invoices, BOLT 12 offers and BIP 353 names

ln_address_pay.note: user@domain resolves only as a BIP 353 name, not through LNURL-pay

ln_address_receive.note: Receive gives a BOLT 11 invoice or a BOLT 12 offer; no hosted address

bip353.note: ₿name@domain resolves to an offer, with DNSSEC checked on the device rather than trusting the resolver

mpp.note: Single-part payments only; the advertised features exclude MPP

keysend.note: Keysend TLV used only internally for async payments; no user keysend

choose_peer.note: Olympus by ZEUS, Megalith, LNServer Wave, or import any node profile; one channel

jit_channels.note: LSPS1 inbound purchase (Olympus, Megalith); the setup fee is paid from another wallet; no LSPS2

anchors.note: Negotiates option_anchors for new channels; older channels keep static-remotekey

local_pathfinding.note: For BOLT 11, searches a graph of up to 150,000 channels fetched from its channel partner and cached for 10 minutes; one path

watchtower.note: No watchtower; background checks can publish pre-signed penalty and recovery transactions when iOS allows

channel_backup.note: Encrypted recovery file exported by hand; restoring asks the peer to close. iCloud backup is off in the Lightning app

onchain_independent.note: Single-key BIP86 Taproot wallet; channels are funded from it, not the reverse

multisig.note: Threshold shared savings (e.g. 2-of-3) and MuSig2 accounts

hw_signer.note: PSBT/MuSig2 cosigning with another device (Core tested); hardware wallets unverified

coin_control.note: Automatic coin selection over all spendable UTXOs; coins list read-only

tor.note: No bundled Tor; reaches Tor and I2P Bitcoin peers through a SOCKS gateway you run, found on your Tailscale network or set by hand
